reason: The hypothesis directly transplants the exact intervention (sub-Tg annealing at Tg-5 K for 2 h), the glass-to-glass transition mechanism, and the predicted outcome (enhanced thermal stability) from P9, P10, and P16 onto phosphorus-containing high-entropy alloys, which are only mentioned in P1 and P2 as having enhanced glass-forming ability. The combination is a straightforward application of a known phenomenon to a new alloy system without a new mechanistic link or resolution of a conflict, making it a minor extension of one body of work.
